specs.Gaming Mouse: Step into the game with the ZEB-War M wired gaming mouse, crafted to deliver a smooth and controlled experience for every kind of player.
specs.Adjustable DPI Settings: Switch effortlessly between four DPI levels—1400, 2200, 2600, and 4200—for the accuracy you need in every scenario, from detailed tasks to quick maneuvers.
specs.Soothing Breathing LED Lights: Add flair to your setup with the mouse’s breathing LED glow, which pulses gently to create a calming, ambient lighting effect during use.
specs.Ergonomic Build for Long Sessions: With a lightweight and ergonomic design, the ZEB-War M fits comfortably in your hand and supports extended use without discomfort.
specs.Plug-and-Play Convenience: Skip the setup and dive straight into the game. The gold-plated USB connector ensures reliable performance with simple plug-and-play connectivity.
